Backlog: #228 (BL-083), #117 (BL-223), #116 (BL-228), #118 (BL-229). Evidence first: #224 (BL-224), #227 (BL-225), #114 (BL-226), #115 (BL-227). The Resume cutoff in #101 is declined. #221 (JS-150) and #220 (JS-151) are the owner's decisions, D-033; BL-230 is not opened.
